posts.text:
New by me for Pressing Issues:

I connected with Richard LA's legal team about the latest in his immigration case and how, even after being detained for more than 300 days, he is still continues to report from his cell in Adelanto.
posts.summary: Highlights detained immigrant journalist's continued reporting despite prolonged detention

An excellent piece for Pressing Issues from A. Rima Dael, CEO of @nfcb.bsky.social, that could not be plainer: "We have a lot to learn from community broadcasters in rural America."

Strong data about community broadcasting and why they cannot be ignored in the future of better media in the US.
posts.summary: Emphasizes importance of community broadcasters for future U.S. media landscape
